info.title: G ROAD LINES API
info.description: Transport Business Operating System. All clients use these secured APIs; none connect to the database.

post.description: OTP sign-in for drivers (and temporary attached drivers). Response is identical whether or not the phone exists.
Bank account changes are a top fraud risk: a new account stays `pending` until a different user approves.
FTL → PTL only with explicit recorded consent, a revised accepted quotation and re-booking.

get.description: Rank available vehicles/drivers for a booking by passing checks (AI-free deterministic recommendation).

post.description: Dedicated tracker feed (own vehicles). Authenticated by a shared key set in GRL_TRACKER_KEY (MOCK until vendor verified).

get.description: QR label payloads (the QR encodes only the opaque label, never customer details).
Public QR verification. Shows authenticity and status only - no customer details.

post.description: Bounced cheque / reversal: reverses the voucher and the invoice allocations.
Routine polite pre-due/due/overdue reminders via approved template. Never threatens or changes terms.
Dry run: parse and validate. Nothing is posted until a different user approves the batch.
Proposes compensation/receivable entries. Nothing is posted or paid until a claim approver approves.
Exit revokes system access immediately and creates handover tasks.

Replays offline events in original-time order. Re-sending the same client_event_id returns the stored result
(idempotent). Payments, statutory and credit approvals are never accepted offline.
Portal bookings must come from an accepted quotation (prices are never set by the customer).
Creates a gateway order. Payment is confirmed ONLY by a server-side gateway confirmation + bank reconciliation.

get.description: Only verified service locations are published.
